title: Alibaba’s AI cloud revenue set to surge over 50% as investment blitz pays off: analysts
source_used: Proactive (text read on Yahoo Finance), on a Jefferies forecast; SCMP original blocked
key_facts: Jefferies forecasts that Alibaba's AI Cloud and Compute services revenue will rise more than 50% year on year to 60.5 billion yuan in the September quarter.
That is ahead of consensus growth of 48%, and the segment margin is expected to improve to 12.3%.
Jefferies expects cloud revenue growth to accelerate in the December and March quarters, with external cloud revenue growing faster than overall cloud revenue.
Alibaba's total September-quarter revenue is expected to rise 9.6% year on year, in line with consensus.
Jefferies forecasts overall EBITA (a profit measure) of 30.4 billion yuan, above consensus of 26.7 billion yuan.
Jefferies kept its Buy rating and named Alibaba a top pick, citing execution across its AI businesses, new Qwen models and higher T-Head chip shipments.
